company.name: Rollstack
company.shortDescription: Rollstack automatically creates and updates slide decks and documents.
company.description: Rollstack automatically generates and updates slide decks and documents reports using data from various sources, including Business Intelligence (BI) tools, CRMs, and data warehouses. Fortune 500 and mid-sized companies use Rollstack to automate leadership reporting, business reviews, financial reporting, and client presentations.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automatically creates and updates slide decks and documents by connecting to BI and analytics tools, embedding visualizations, and scheduling updates.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack Automated Slide Decks and Documents

productsAndServices.description: An AI feature that analyzes embedded data and visualizations in presentations and documents to generate contextual insights and summaries for decision-making.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack AI-Powered Data Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A tool to create and automate multiple variants of presentations and documents at scale using templates connected to live data sources.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack Scaled Content Generation with Templates

productsAndServices.description: A built-in functionality to automatically distribute updated presentations and documents via email or communication platforms like Slack.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack Report Distribution and Sharing

productsAndServices.description: Connectors that link popular business intelligence and analytics tools like Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, and Google Sheets to presentation and document platforms for automated data updates.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack Data Source Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Platform features that provide role-based access control, user permissions, single sign-on, and local data storage to ensure secure and compliant data-driven reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Rollstack Governance and Security Features

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 85.11% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,289,830 to $60,486,408, a 14.1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 57 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
